title: Google Drive
description: Mounts Google Drive folders as Harnesys knowledge sources. The add-on talks to the Drive v3 API with the org's bound Google account; the token never leaves the add-on process. Folders are mirrored by the core source pipeline through this add-on's source.* handlers, and local edits are written back.

permissions.reason: Call the Google Drive v3 API with the bound account
Use the Google account bound to the source connection
Serve Google Drive folders as knowledge sources for the host mirror pipeline
